This is Worldline. 
 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
 The Opportunity 
 We are seeking a DevOps Engineer to support and maintain our Single Sign-On (SSO) service. You will ensure reliable authentication, identity federation, and smooth integration with downstream systems. Knowledge of infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and secure access patterns is essential.
 Day-to-Day Responsibilities 
Maintain and operate the SSO service (authentication, authorization, token lifecycles, session management).
Monitor reliability, performance, and security; implement alerting and incident response processes.
Manage identity providers (SAML/OIDC), metadata exchange, and federation configurations.
Collaborate with developers and security teams to implement identity-related features and fixes.
Ensure secure secret management, key rotation, and certificate handling.
Maintain IaC for SSO infrastructure and related components; implement reproducible environments.
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for SSO deployment, migrations, and rollbacks.
Document architecture, runbooks, and standard operating procedures.
Perform on-call rotation and post-incident reviews; drive continuous improvement.
 Who Are We Looking For 
 We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:
This role requires Linux proficiency and experience operating services on Linux-based environments.
3+ years in platform/DevOps or SRE roles with SSO or identity-related work.
Strong experience with Terraform and infrastructure automation.
Proficiency with GitLab CI/CD or similar pipelines; experience automating builds, tests, and deployments.
Familiarity with IAM concepts, SAML, OIDC, OAuth, and federation mechanisms.
Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) and secure secret management.
Scripting skills (e.g., Bash, Python) for automation and tooling.
Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
 Nice to have:
Experience with LDAP/AD, SCIM, or enterprise identity providers.
Knowledge of security hardening, auditing, and compliance practices.
VM orchestration and related tooling.
 Perks & Benefits 
 At Worldline you’ll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:
Hybrid Working Policy
Gift vouchers on the occasion of Christmas/Easter Holidays
Private medical services
21 vacation days/year
Referral bonuses for new hires recommended by you
WFH & Flexible Working Hours
Full access to the “Learning” platform
 Shape the evolution. 
 We are pushing towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers to join our journey. People with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you’ll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. And with our empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career. Wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of over 18,000 innovators across 40+ countries, and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
 Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com
